paragraphs.source_en: The fourth through sixth years of Tenshō were three years of hibernation for Tokugawa Ieyasu, but for Oda Nobunaga they were a time of unprecedented activity, during which he fully consolidated his supremacy.

units.source_zh: 天正四至六年，是德川家康蛰伏的三年，而这三年对织田信长来说，则是完全巩固霸业、空前活跃的时期。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga built Azuchi Castle, an immense project without precedent. His domains encompassed Yamato, Tanba, and Harima, yielding five million koku annually, while his court rank rose to Senior Second Rank and his office from Minister of the Center to Minister of the Right.

units.source_en: Nobunaga built Azuchi Castle, an immense project without precedent. His domains encompassed Yamato, Tanba, and Harima, yielding five million koku annually, while his court rank rose to Senior Second Rank and his office from Minister of the Center to Minister of the Right.
units.source_zh: 信长修筑了史无前例的庞大工程——安土城，他掌握的领地包括大和、丹波、播磨，年赋达到五百万石，官位迁至正二品，由内大臣升到了右大臣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长修筑了史无前例的庞大工程——安土城，他掌握的领地包括大和、丹波、播磨，年赋达到五百万石，官位迁至正二品，由内大臣升到了右大臣。

paragraphs.source_en: Historically, Minamoto no Yoritomo, who founded the Kamakura shogunate at Kamakura, had risen to General of the Right, while Taira no Shigemori's highest office under the Taira regime had been Minister of the Center. Thus, on the eleventh day of the fifth month of Tenshō Seven, when Nobunaga completed Azuchi Castle and moved into its keep, his office already surpassed those of Yoritomo and Shigemori.

paragraphs.source_en: In the twelve-mat western hall, the doors and windows were of gold, and Kano Eitoku's celebrated painting of plum blossoms hung within. The study displayed Evening Bell at a Distant Temple; the shelves in the adjoining room bore a painting of doves. The central hall, also twelve mats in size, held a painting of vultures; pheasant paintings adorned the neighboring eight- and four-mat rooms; and the twelve-mat southern hall was decorated with portraits of Chinese Confucian scholars.
